headline: The attack that pushed America into Vietnam never happened.
slides: North Vietnamese boats attacked the destroyer USS Maddox in the Gulf of Tonkin. That part was real.
US ships reported a second attack, in the dark and in bad weather.
Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution. 416-0 in the House, 88-2 in the Senate.
McNamara asked North Vietnam's General Giáp what happened on August 4. 'Absolutely nothing.'
The NSA declassified its own historian's study: there was no second attack.
It concluded intelligence had been 'skewed' to fit the story of an attack.
sources: Sources: NSA 'Skunks, Bogies, Silent Hounds, and the Flying Fish' (Hanyok, declassified 2005), National Security Archive
